questionTemplates.rank: Confirm the complete rank range and any rank-specific unlocks against the 1.2.1 Codex.
questionTemplates.rarity: Confirm minimum rarity and every supported rarity in 1.2.1.
questionTemplates.pool: Confirm ordinary, branching, starting, or finale availability and source account gating.
questionTemplates.prerequisites: Confirm the complete nested prerequisite expression, including minimum ranks.
questionTemplates.exclusions: Confirm all bans, rank caps, and asymmetric acquisition-order exceptions.
questionTemplates.affinity: Confirm every affinity and per-pick gain or loss in 1.2.1.
questionTemplates.trigger: Confirm event, target, duration, ownership, and protection interactions.
questionTemplates.numericalTables: Confirm starting-action values against 1.2.1. Do not use the learned Body Slam table.
questionTemplates.specializations: Confirm all specialization options, their trigger rank, exact effects, and skip behavior.

conflictResolutionPolicy: When the community wiki and Neoseeker disagree, use the wiki value by user decision. Retain Neoseeker observations for provenance. This preference does not establish historical version fidelity or implement gameplay.
